summary: Re-shipped last night's five fixes (its merge was cancelled by a hung CI runner, not a failing test) and fixed a false 'routine overran' warning: the watchdog counted the owner's mark-uploaded, edit and remove clicks as part of the morning video run.
why: The 23 Oct branch's Python step hung 40 min without output and passes locally in 19 s. The watchdog bug makes any video marked uploaded later the same day look like a 9-hour main run. The data audit is 24 h old (its cron moved after today's slot), so the data check was skipped.
